title: FloodVR voice notes
description: Request and response for POST /voice. The adjuster taps to talk in VR, Safari speech recognition produces a transcript, and this turns it into a structured update or a short spoken answer. Proposed by Windows for Mac 2 to consume — comment before building against it.

transcript.description: Raw speech-to-text. TREATED AS UNTRUSTED and passed through the guard: anyone standing near the adjuster can speak at the microphone.

standpoint.description: Where the adjuster is standing, e.g. StandPoint_Kitchen_1. Used to resolve 'this' and 'that one'.

gaze_item_id.description: The damage id the adjuster is looking at, if the app knows it. Resolves deictic references.

audit_trail_id.description: The /assess run this note attaches to.

kind.description: answer = a question was answered. update = the claim draft gained a note. refused = the guard blocked the transcript.

spoken_reply.description: One or two sentences to read back in the headset. Short: it is heard, not read.

updates.description: Structured changes proposed by the note. These are PROPOSALS recorded on the draft; they never alter coverage or cost on their own.

field.description: Deliberately NOT coverage, peril or estimate. A spoken sentence cannot move money or change a policy determination.

citations.description: What the answer was grounded in, e.g. policy:FL-EXCL-1, manifest:kitchen_ceiling_stain.
